Class GPoint

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.react.events.EventEmitter
com.j3d.engine.react.events.EventEmitterAndListener
com.j3d.engine.scene.nodes.geometry.GObject
com.j3d.engine.scene.nodes.geometry.GPoint
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventEmitterInterface, EventListener, CanCopy, DecomposeWhenDrawn<Point>, HasParents<GObject>, SceneObject, HasProperties
public final class GPoint extends GObject implements HasParents<GObject>, DecomposeWhenDrawn<Point>
GPoint is a class that represents a single point in 3D space.

Unlike other GObjects who's pivot has to be calculated to be it's geometric centre, a GPoint's pivot is just its position.

a Thing stores GPoints separately as they form the core of any transformation irrespective of whether it's part of some other geometry. This means all transformations need to be point based and applied to the GPoint.

A GPoint is also stored within SceneManager.points for redundancy.
